floor_z_m.method: owner's tape measure: LeKiwi base top 100 mm above the floor

floor_tcp_z_m.frame: arm base (so101_kinematics), TCP pointing straight down, gripper closed
floor_tcp_z_m.method: calibrate_floor.py probe 2 (fixed contact rule: measured TCP held above its free-air sag by > 1.5 mm, 3 mm steps); value at x 0.22 m

probes.run: probe 1, re-scored offline (live run missed contact)

floor_tcp_z_m.validity: the model's floor reading drops ~1 mm per cm of reach (-0.1145 at x 0.22, -0.1194 at 0.27): arm-model/sag error, not floor tilt; final grasp heights must close on contact or the wrist camera

wrist_image_jacobian.unit: image fraction (u right, v down) per metre of measured TCP motion (arm base x, y)
wrist_image_jacobian.pose: TCP pointing straight down, roll 0, near (0.22, 0, 0.0): jaw tips ~10 cm above the floor
wrist_image_jacobian.method: wrist_calib.py: +/-0.02 m moves, Gemma E4B box centres, least squares over 6 frames (rms 4.9 px)
wrist_image_jacobian.validity: one height; pixel motion scales roughly with 1/height, so re-measure or scale for other heights

wrist_grasp_pixel.unit: wrist image fraction (u right, v down) of the Gemma box centre; height = measured TCP z - floor_tcp_z
wrist_grasp_pixel.meaning: where the block appears when it sits where the jaws will grip it (flush against the fixed jaw, centred on the jaw blades), at each gripper height; TCP pointing straight down, roll 0
wrist_grasp_pixel.method: teach 2026-10-23: owner placed the block between the open jaws; the first close nudged it flush against the fixed jaw (no grip: jaws too high); frames from the closed pose and straight lifts of 3, 6, 10 cm
wrist_grasp_pixel.validity: single teach; the block's long side along robot y (left-right)

front_camera.method: calibrate_front.py: turn test, straight drive at a brick, wrist check at the reach point

wrist_jaws.unit: wrist image fraction (u right, v down)
wrist_jaws.meaning: fixed jaw (right) in the wrist image: its tip row and its inner edge column just below the tip
wrist_jaws.method: median of jaw_geometry over 213 saved plan_wrist/pre_close frames
